description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai West Coast
We are very happy to welcome Ms. Sofia from Brazil. It was a warm Welcome accorded to her at the Airport. The Host Family - Mr. and Mrs. Rahul Kulkarni was present at the airport along with the other two host family members - Dr. Arun Choudhary and Dr. Nilima Inamdar. Rotary members were also present at the Airport to welcome with our club banner being Displayed.
